kandoInfo.heading: Kando Martial Arts Knox
description: Kando Martial Arts was established in 1997 by Chief Instructor Shihan Paul Veldman, a highly respected martial arts instructor with decades of experience.
Shihan Paul is a 6th Degree Black Belt in Karate and began training at age 13, later specialising in traditional Shukokai Karate.
Sensei Andy started karate at a young age and developed confidence, resilience, and leadership through years of dedicated training.
With over a decade of teaching experience, Sensei Andy now leads Kando Martial Arts Knox, delivering high-quality karate instruction to families from across the Knox area.
Kando Martial Arts Knox proudly supports students travelling from Scoresby with structured, traditional karate training.

The drive from Scoresby to our Boronia dojo usually takes around 10 to 15 minutes. Take Stud Road heading north toward Boronia, then turn onto Burwood Highway. From Burwood Highway, turn into Lewis Road, followed by a turn into Wadhurst Drive. Our facility is located at Unit 2/5 Wadhurst Drive, Boronia.
